banned_rule.why: purple / violet / blue neon / cyan glow = the generic 'AI' look Sujon banned (Nov 3, 2026: 'Perpel colour aur a sab ai genetic colour use mat kato'). v5.2 widened the range to 175-320 deg so cyan glow and magenta-purple are caught too.

meta.how_to_fill: Open each sheet, look at every frame, fill the empty fields in seconds[] and events[]. Then run: python3 ref_breakdown.py md <this folder>
meta.filled_by: machine facts (60 fps decode: motion, cuts, colours, audio onsets) + Tab's own viewing of 2 fps contact sheets (every 0.5 s). Rows are marked viewed; nothing here claims every 60 fps frame was looked at by eye.

summary: Hook = glossy 3D '2026' + avatar, then a chat-bubble proof scene, then a tilted 3D screen that carries a real screen-recording tutorial (install -> open panel -> click presets), CTA = profile card + 'COMMENT PLUGIN'.
Only 3 hard cuts (3.4 s white flash, 16.8 s screen flip, 23.5 s); the rest is continuous screen-recording inside the floating card.
Palette: peach/salmon light gradient with cyan-blue chrome text + glow = banned for us.
make_it_ours: Text: ink/off-white heavy grotesk + serif italic accent (no cyan chrome, no glow)
Background: paper/studio texture with warm gradient, never rainbow
Screen: our own UI built in code (templates/ui_screen_v5), labelled concept
